anthropic.scope: Original synthetic text only; relationship judgments, not embeddings or lyric analysis.

protocol.selected_retrieval: MiniLM hybrid rewrite enabled, neighbors disabled
protocol.evaluation_scope: Posthoc support review of frozen test contexts; assistant labels only. Empty gated contexts remain empty for both providers.
protocol.privacy: Only OpenAI receives private context blocks in this run. Gemini inference canceled. Anthropic receives original synthetic sentences only. Public whitelist excludes all model-written claims, uncertainty text and lyric content.

topic_labels.editorial_format_revision: After one failed format repair, two-word labels were permitted. Semantic, citation and five-word lyric-overlap checks are unchanged. No extra requests for this revision.
topic_labels.selection: At most 3 nearest-centroid blocks from distinct songs per frozen seed-17 non-noise cluster. Maximum 100 words per block.
topic_labels.privacy: Private representative text and raw model output; public original labels screened for five-word lyric overlap.
topic_labels.limitation: Postfit LLM proposals based on sampled representatives. Not human validation, calibrated confidence, complete cluster coverage, emotion gold or discovered new subtopics.
